rubrics.justification: Accurately interprets the provided Gardner 3AA data, including expanded blastocyst, excellent ICM and TE, and thinning zona; however, no actual image was available, so the analysis cannot be truly image-specific or more detailed.

Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, BMI, prior IVF outcome, sperm quality, protocol, and missing endometrial data with embryo quality, including noting the inconsistency between DOR diagnosis and AMH/FSH.

Reasoning is generally logical and well structured, with appropriate caveats around prognosis; minor issues include overinterpreting the DOR discrepancy and some speculative links from oocyte yield to embryo competence.

Mostly aligned on SET and luteal support, but recommendations such as considering endometrial scratch and thrombophilia screening are not routinely guideline-supported, and PGT-A rationale in a young patient after one failed cycle is somewhat overstated.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, uterine evaluation, and review of prior cycle details, though some suggestions are broader than necessary and not all are strongly evidence-based.
